newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket-India add rookie spinner to Caribbean squad.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-India add rookie spinner to Caribbean squad.

text.p: India added uncapped off-spinner Noel David on Tuesday to the squad touring West Indies, while continuing to hope for injured Javagal Srinath's return.
Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) secretary Jagmohan Dalmiya said the selectors picked David following captain Sachin Tendulkar's and coach Madan Lal's requests to bolster the spin attack.
The team management had sought an additional spinner due to the placid pitches in the Caribbean.
Dalmiya told reporters the board would await final word from Srinath's orthopaedic surgeon before deciding to pull the pace bowler out of the squad.
Srinath, who left Kingston for Johannesburg on Monday, will be treated for a tear of the rotator cuff by the same surgeon who treated him last month during India's tour of South Africa.
"If he is fit enough for the final two tests we would be happy to have him back...he is our leading bowler," Lal said in Kingston.
Depending on the outcome of the treatment, Srinath will either rejoin the team in the West Indies or return to India for further treatment or surgery, Dalmiya said.
Srinath has a recent history of shoulder injuries and missed the one-off home test against Australia late last year because of the problem.
Medium-fast bowler Salil Ankola has been named the standby for Srinath if he is not fit to rejoin the squad after being medically examined, Dalmiya said.
David, 21, will leave for the West Indies in a day or two but will not be able to report in time for the first test in Kingston beginning on Thursday, he said.
